rationale: B and A are both character-perfect and complete; B ranks first because its markdown headers reflect the layout more naturally than A's one-row table for the unit banner, while both handle the connection-form box similarly. C ranks last due to an inserted extra 「は」 that corrupts the final paragraph, consistent use of half-width slashes instead of the full-width slashes visible in the image, and a table structure that collapses the box's left-column label into the content, misrepresenting the layout.
